test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Out of the four words listed, three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
By checking options: 

All latch, seal, and lock are used to fix or hold something up (lock).

Whereas,

Key is used to unlock something.

Hence, **key **is the odd one out.
